before.text: The item's order system is SIC, it has no Items - Planning row, its default supply source is Purchase, and it has one buy-from business partner. Its reorder point and order method are set in Item - Ordering (tcibd2600m000), or per site in Items - Ordering by Site (tcibd2150m000).

tokens.v: SIC, statistical inventory control, plans by stock level, not by demand. When the economic stock, on hand plus on order less allocated, falls below the item's reorder point, generating order advice proposes an order, sized by the item's order method. It suits cheap items with steady demand. It does not explode bills of material, use forecasts, or make distribution orders.
